## Checklist
- [ ] It builds: `cmake --build build`
- [ ] Tests pass: `QT_QPA_PLATFORM=offscreen ./build/paintdotnet_tests`
- [ ] I added/updated a test if it fixes a bug or adds behavior
- [ ] The change is focused on a single topic

> The maintainer will review and give the final approval before merging.
